newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Selecta surges 7.22 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Selecta surges 7.22 pct in early trade.

text.p: Selecta Dairy Products Inc rose by 14 centavos, or 7.22 percent, to 2.08 pesos a share in early Friday trade on expectations of a recovery in consumer stocks, brokers said.

"All signs point to a recovery in 1997 for Selecta as well as the food and beverage sector due to lower prices of raw materials and the fact that the forward contracts they've entered into would end," Spencer Yap, BPI Capital Corp research head said.
He said Selecta had this year signed forward contracts for the supply of raw materials at higher prices which was affecting its profits.
Yap said that Selecta was one of the few consumer stocks that had not been moving on expectations of a turnaround next year by the food sector.
Performance of most food and beverage companies were better in the third quarter compared to the first six months of the year, Yap added.
A total of 3.685 million Selecta shares changed hands in early trade.
Most of the consumer issues such as RFM Corp and San Miguel showed gains early in the session.
